eevee.name: gi_diffuse_bounces
eevee.label: Diffuse Bounces
eevee.description: Number of times the light is reinjected inside light grids, 0 disable indirect diffuse light

eevee.name: gi_cubemap_resolution
eevee.label: Cubemap Size
eevee.description: Size of every cubemaps

eevee.name: gi_visibility_resolution
eevee.label: Irradiance Visibility Size
eevee.description: Size of the shadow map applied to each irradiance sample

eevee.name: gi_glossy_clamp
eevee.label: Clamp Glossy
eevee.description: Clamp pixel intensity to reduce noise inside glossy reflections from reflection cubemaps (0 to disable)

eevee.name: gi_irradiance_pool_size
eevee.label: Irradiance Pool Size
eevee.description: Size of the irradiance pool, a bigger pool size allows for more irradiance grid in the scene but might not fit into GPU memory and decrease performance

eevee.name: taa_samples
eevee.label: Viewport Samples
eevee.description: Number of samples, unlimited if 0

eevee.name: taa_render_samples
eevee.label: Render Samples
eevee.description: Number of samples per pixel for rendering

eevee.name: use_taa_reprojection
eevee.label: Viewport Denoising
eevee.description: Denoise image using temporal reprojection (can leave some ghosting)

eevee.name: ray_tracing_method
eevee.label: Tracing Method
eevee.description: Select the tracing method used to find scene-ray intersections
items: Use light probes to find scene intersection
Raytrace against the depth buffer. Fallback to light probes for invalid rays.

eevee.name: use_shadow_jitter_viewport
eevee.label: Jittered Shadows (Viewport)
eevee.description: Enable jittered shadows on the viewport. (Jittered shadows are always enabled for final renders).

eevee.name: clamp_surface_direct
eevee.label: Clamp Surface Direct
eevee.description: If non-zero, the maximum value for lights contribution on a surface. Higher values will be scaled down to avoid too much noise and slow convergence at the cost of accuracy. Used by light objects.

eevee.name: clamp_surface_indirect
eevee.label: Clamp Surface Indirect
eevee.description: If non-zero, the maximum value for indirect lighting on surface. Higher values will be scaled down to avoid too much noise and slow convergence at the cost of accuracy. Used by ray-tracing and light-probes.

eevee.name: clamp_volume_direct
eevee.label: Clamp Volume Direct
eevee.description: If non-zero, the maximum value for lights contribution in volumes. Higher values will be scaled down to avoid too much noise and slow convergence at the cost of accuracy. Used by light objects.

eevee.name: clamp_volume_indirect
eevee.label: Clamp Volume Indirect
eevee.description: If non-zero, the maximum value for indirect lighting in volumes. Higher values will be scaled down to avoid too much noise and slow convergence at the cost of accuracy. Used by light-probes.

eevee.name: direct_light_intensity
eevee.label: Direct Light Strength
eevee.description: Scale the contribution of direct lighting

eevee.name: indirect_light_intensity
eevee.label: Indirect Light Strength
eevee.description: Scale the contribution of indirect lighting

eevee.name: volumetric_start
eevee.label: Start
eevee.description: Start distance of the volumetric effect

eevee.name: volumetric_end
eevee.label: End
eevee.description: End distance of the volumetric effect

eevee.name: volumetric_tile_size
eevee.label: Resolution
eevee.description: Control the quality of the volumetric effects. Higher resolution uses more memory.
items: Render this effect at 50% render resolution
Render this effect at 25% render resolution
Render this effect at 12.5% render resolution
Render this effect at 6.25% render resolution

eevee.name: volumetric_samples
eevee.label: Steps
eevee.description: Number of steps to compute volumetric effects. Higher step count increase VRAM usage and quality.

eevee.name: volumetric_sample_distribution
eevee.label: Exponential Sampling
eevee.description: Distribute more samples closer to the camera

eevee.name: volumetric_ray_depth
eevee.label: Volume Max Ray Depth
eevee.description: Maximum surface intersection count used by the accurate volume intersection method. Will create artifact if it is exceeded. Higher count increases VRAM usage.

eevee.name: volumetric_light_clamp
eevee.label: Clamp
eevee.description: Maximum light contribution, reducing noise

eevee.name: use_volumetric_shadows
eevee.label: Volumetric Shadows
eevee.description: Cast shadows from volumetric materials onto volumetric materials (Very expensive)

eevee.name: volumetric_shadow_samples
eevee.label: Volumetric Shadow Samples
eevee.description: Number of samples to compute volumetric shadowing

eevee.name: use_volume_custom_range
eevee.label: Volume Custom Range
eevee.description: Enable custom start and end clip distances for volume computation

eevee.name: use_fast_gi
eevee.label: Fast GI Approximation
eevee.description: Use faster global illumination technique for high roughness surfaces

eevee.name: fast_gi_thickness_near
eevee.label: Thickness
eevee.description: Geometric thickness of the surfaces when computing fast GI and ambient occlusion. Reduces light leaking and missing contact occlusion.

eevee.name: fast_gi_quality
eevee.label: Trace Precision
eevee.description: Precision of the fast GI ray marching

eevee.name: fast_gi_step_count
eevee.label: Step Count
eevee.description: Amount of screen sample per GI ray

eevee.name: fast_gi_ray_count
eevee.label: Ray Count
eevee.description: Amount of GI ray to trace for each pixel

eevee.name: fast_gi_method
eevee.label: Method
eevee.description: Fast GI approximation method
items: Use ambient occlusion instead of full global illumination
Compute global illumination taking into account light bouncing off surrounding objects

eevee.name: fast_gi_distance
eevee.label: Distance
eevee.description: If non-zero, the maximum distance at which other surfaces will contribute to the fast GI approximation

eevee.name: fast_gi_bias
eevee.label: Bias
eevee.description: Bias the shading normal to reduce self intersection artifacts

eevee.name: fast_gi_resolution
eevee.label: Resolution
eevee.description: Control the quality of the fast GI lighting. Higher resolution uses more memory.
items: Render this effect at 50% render resolution
Render this effect at 25% render resolution
Render this effect at 12.5% render resolution
Render this effect at 6.25% render resolution

eevee.name: bokeh_max_size
eevee.label: Max Size
eevee.description: Max size of the bokeh shape for the depth of field (lower is faster)

eevee.name: bokeh_threshold
eevee.label: Sprite Threshold
eevee.description: Brightness threshold for using sprite base depth of field

eevee.name: bokeh_neighbor_max
eevee.label: Neighbor Rejection
eevee.description: Maximum brightness to consider when rejecting bokeh sprites based on neighborhood (lower is faster)

eevee.name: use_bokeh_jittered
eevee.label: Jitter Camera
eevee.description: Jitter camera position to create accurate blurring using render samples (only for final render)

eevee.name: bokeh_overblur
eevee.label: Over-blur
eevee.description: Apply blur to each jittered sample to reduce under-sampling artifacts

eevee.name: motion_blur_depth_scale
eevee.label: Bleeding Bias
eevee.description: Lower values will reduce background bleeding onto foreground elements

eevee.name: motion_blur_max
eevee.label: Max Blur
eevee.description: Maximum blur distance a pixel can spread over

eevee.name: motion_blur_steps
eevee.label: Motion steps
eevee.description: Controls accuracy of motion blur, more steps means longer render time

eevee.name: use_shadows
eevee.label: Shadows
eevee.description: Enable shadow casting from lights

eevee.name: shadow_pool_size
eevee.label: Shadow Pool Size
eevee.description: Size of the shadow pool, a bigger pool size allows for more shadows in the scene but might not fit into GPU memory

eevee.name: shadow_ray_count
eevee.label: Shadow Ray Count
eevee.description: Amount of shadow ray to trace for each light

eevee.name: shadow_step_count
eevee.label: Shadow Step Count
eevee.description: Amount of shadow map sample per shadow ray

eevee.name: light_threshold
eevee.label: Light Threshold
eevee.description: Minimum light intensity for a light to contribute to the lighting

eevee.name: use_overscan
eevee.label: Overscan
eevee.description: Internally render past the image border to avoid screen-space effects disappearing

eevee.name: overscan_size
eevee.label: Overscan Size
eevee.description: Percentage of render size to add as overscan to the internal render buffers

eevee.name: use_raytracing
eevee.label: Use Ray-Tracing
eevee.description: Enable the ray-tracing module

eevee.name: shadow_resolution_scale
eevee.label: Shadows Resolution Scale
eevee.description: Resolution percentage of shadow maps

ray_tracing_options.name: resolution_scale
ray_tracing_options.label: Resolution
ray_tracing_options.description: Determines the number of rays per pixel. Higher resolution uses more memory.
items: Render this effect at 50% render resolution
Render this effect at 25% render resolution
Render this effect at 12.5% render resolution
Render this effect at 6.25% render resolution

ray_tracing_options.name: use_backface_hit
ray_tracing_options.label: Hit Backfaces
ray_tracing_options.description: Consider rays hitting backfaces as valid

ray_tracing_options.name: backface_radiance_scale
ray_tracing_options.label: Backface Radiance Scale
ray_tracing_options.description: Amount of the front face lighting to reuse for backface lighting approximation

ray_tracing_options.name: use_denoise
ray_tracing_options.label: Denoise
ray_tracing_options.description: Enable noise reduction techniques for raytraced effects

ray_tracing_options.name: denoise_temporal
ray_tracing_options.label: Temporal Accumulation
ray_tracing_options.description: Accumulate samples by reprojecting last tracing results

ray_tracing_options.name: denoise_bilateral
ray_tracing_options.label: Bilateral Filter
ray_tracing_options.description: Blur the resolved radiance using a bilateral filter

ray_tracing_options.name: screen_trace_thickness
ray_tracing_options.label: Screen-Trace Thickness
ray_tracing_options.description: Surface thickness used to detect intersection when using screen-tracing

ray_tracing_options.name: trace_max_roughness
ray_tracing_options.label: Raytrace Max Roughness
ray_tracing_options.description: Maximum roughness to use the tracing pipeline for. Higher roughness surfaces will use fast GI approximation. A value of 1 will disable fast GI approximation.

ray_tracing_options.name: screen_trace_quality
ray_tracing_options.label: Screen-Trace Precision
ray_tracing_options.description: Precision of the screen space ray-tracing

render.name: dither_intensity
render.label: Dither Intensity
render.description: Amount of dithering noise added to the rendered image to break up banding

render.name: filter_size
render.label: Filter Size
render.description: Width over which the reconstruction filter combines samples

render.name: film_transparent
render.label: Transparent
render.description: World background is transparent, for compositing the render over another background

render.name: motion_blur_shutter
render.label: Shutter
render.description: Time taken in frames between shutter open and close

render.name: motion_blur_position
render.label: Motion Blur Position
render.description: Offset for the shutter's time interval, allows to change the motion blur trails
items: The shutter opens at the current frame
The shutter is open during the current frame
The shutter closes at the current frame

render.name: use_high_quality_normals
render.label: High Quality Normals
render.description: Use high quality tangent space at the cost of lower performance

render.name: anisotropic_filter
render.label: Anisotropic Filtering
render.description: Quality of anisotropic filtering in materials

image_settings.name: file_format
image_settings.label: File Format
image_settings.description: File format to save the rendered images as
items: Output image in SGI IRIS format
Output image in Radiance HDR format
Output image in uncompressed Targa format

image_settings.name: color_mode
image_settings.label: Color Mode
image_settings.description: Choose BW for saving grayscale images, RGB for saving red, green and blue channels, and RGBA for saving red, green, blue and alpha channels
items: Images get saved in 8-bit grayscale (only PNG, JPEG, TGA, TIF)
Images are saved with RGB (color) data
Images are saved with RGB and Alpha data (if supported)

image_settings.name: quality
image_settings.label: Quality
image_settings.description: Quality for image formats that support lossy compression

image_settings.name: compression
image_settings.label: Compression
image_settings.description: Amount of time to determine best compression: 0 = no compression with fast file output, 100 = maximum lossless compression with slow file output

image_settings.name: use_preview
image_settings.label: Preview
image_settings.description: When rendering animations, save JPG preview images in same directory

image_settings.name: exr_codec
image_settings.label: Codec
items: Lossless zip compression of 16 row image blocks
Lossless wavelet compression, effective for noisy/grainy images
JPEG-like lossy compression on 32 row image blocks
JPEG-like lossy compression on 256 row image blocks
Lossless compression based on high throughput JPEG 2000 encoding. It produces smaller files, but it is new and not widely supported by other software yet.
Lossless zip compression, each image row compressed separately
Lossy compression for 32 bit float images (stores 24 bits of each float)
Lossy compression for 16 bit float images, at fixed 2.3:1 ratio
Lossy compression for 16 bit float images, at fixed 2.3:1 ratio

image_settings.name: use_exr_interleave
image_settings.label: Interleave
image_settings.description: Use legacy interleaved storage of views, layers and passes for compatibility with applications that do not support more efficient multi-part OpenEXR files.

image_settings.name: use_jpeg2k_ycc
image_settings.label: YCC
image_settings.description: Save luminance-chrominance-chrominance channels instead of RGB colors

view_settings.name: look
view_settings.label: Look
view_settings.description: Additional transform applied before view transform for artistic needs

view_settings.name: view_transform
view_settings.label: View
view_settings.description: View used when converting image to a display space

view_settings.name: exposure
view_settings.label: Exposure
view_settings.description: Exposure (stops) applied before display transform, multiplying by 2^exposure

view_settings.name: gamma
view_settings.label: Gamma
view_settings.description: Additional gamma encoding after display transform, for output with custom gamma

view_settings.name: use_white_balance
view_settings.label: Use White Balance
view_settings.description: Perform chromatic adaption from a different white point

view_settings.name: white_balance_temperature
view_settings.label: Temperature
view_settings.description: Color temperature of the scene's white point

view_settings.name: white_balance_tint
view_settings.label: Tint
view_settings.description: Color tint of the scene's white point (the default of 10 matches daylight)
